newsitem.title: UK: Brazil's Malan says October trade deficit unusual.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Malan says October trade deficit unusual.

text.p: Finance Minister Pedro Malan said Brazil's October trade deficit was unusual but easily financeable, and the country was planning no hasty action to counteract it.

"When the figures for November come up shortly they will show that October was a peculiar month, for a variety of reasons," he told a Mercosur conference in London, pointing to special and seasonal factors.
"We are not concerned at all and we don't think people should engage in naive and mechanical statistical exercises multiplying that (October) figure by 12 and saying it is a trend," he said.
Brazil shocked investors when its October trade deficit came in worse than expected at $1.3 billion. But Malan denied this posed any financial problem to Brazil.
"It is financeable -- 2.8 percent of GDP is easily financeable," he said, adding Brazil was not planning to take any hasty action.
"We don't feel there is any need to take any precipitous action whatsoever," he said.
